parts.title: The Quiet Pond
parts.text: Ava, Kofi, and Lily sat by the pond. The water was **calm** and clear. A green frog sat on a **slippery** rock. Suddenly it took a big **dive** and went under. Up went a big **splash**!

parts.title: Small Swimmers
parts.text: Kofi looked into the water. He saw a **tadpole** with a long tail. It began to **squirm** and **swish** its tail from side to side. A duck came to **paddle** by. A leaf began to **float** near it.

parts.title: Wet Hands
parts.text: Lily put her hand in the water and made a small **swirl**. The leaf drifted away. Ava had to **stretch** to reach it. Her sleeve fell in and began to **soak** up the water.

parts.title: Time to Go
parts.text: The children dried off in the sun. They watched the pond until the frog came back. It was the best day by the water.

definitions.meaning1: To make something very wet, or to stay in water. Example: I soak my feet in warm water.

definitions.meaning1: To move around and around in a circle. Example: The leaves swirl in the wind.
